title: Shared finite closed restriction and signed-row constructions
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $A$ be a sheaf of commutative rings on its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], and write $\mathcal M_X=\operatorname{Mod}(A)$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Use the compatible small models and coefficient universes of that site. For any scheme morphism $i:Z\to X$, put $E_i=i_*i^*:\mathcal M_X\to\mathcal M_X$, using the actual module inverse image with coefficients $i^{-1}A$ and its direct image [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image, def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. Put $\eta_i:\mathrm{id}\to E_i$ equal to the unit of the normalized adjunction [def-sfb-proetale-unit-normalized-adjunction].

For $m\geq0$ and an ordered family $(W_a\to X)_{a\in\{0,\ldots,m-1\}}$, set $W_s=\prod_{a\in s,X}W_a$ for every subset $s$, with its structural morphism $i_s:W_s\to X$. This is the iterated fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product]; the empty product is $X\xrightarrow{\mathrm{id}}X$. Put $I_p=\{t:\{0,\ldots,p\}\hookrightarrow_{\mathrm{ord}}\{0,\ldots,m-1\}\}$ for $p\geq0$. Define the row term endofunctor by the pointwise finite product $D^p=\prod_{t\in I_p} E_{i_{\mathrm{im}(t)}}$, with projections $\pi_t$. It is the finite biproduct in the additive module category [def-weil-additive-category]; the empty product is the zero functor. Given natural transformations $r_{s,u}:E_{i_s}\to E_{i_u}$ for all pairs of subsets, define $d^p:D^p\to D^{p+1}$ by its components
$$\pi_t\circ d^p=\sum_{j=0}^{p+1}(-1)^j r_{\mathrm{im}(t\circ\delta_j),\mathrm{im}(t)}\circ\pi_{t\circ\delta_j},$$
where $\delta_j:\{0,\ldots,p\}\hookrightarrow_{\mathrm{ord}}\{0,\ldots,p+1\}$ skips $j$. Thus $D^p=0$ for $p\geq m$. This defines the signed morphisms for supplied $r$; the construction of a row functor below takes an actual complex-valued functor as input.

Independently, let $R:\mathcal M_X\to\mathrm{CoCh}(\mathcal M_X)$ be additive [def-weil-pbc-additive-functor], with integer cochain complexes as in [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. For $K\in\mathrm{CoCh}(\mathcal M_X)$ define $B_R(K)^{p,q}=R(K^q)^p$, with horizontal differential $d_{R(K^q)}^p$ and vertical differential $R(d_K^q)^p$. This is the termwise double complex with horizontal row degree first, in the commuting convention [def-sp-double-complex-total]. Define
$$\operatorname{Tot}_R(K)^n=\bigoplus_{p+q=n}R(K^q)^p,\qquad d|_{(p,q)}=d_{R(K^q)}^p+(-1)^pR(d_K^q)^p.$$
On a morphism $h:K\to L$ the double-complex map at $(p,q)$ is $R(h^q)^p$, and the total map is induced by these maps on diagonal coproduct inclusions. Use the ordinary coproduct total, also for unbounded $R,K$; the coproducts exist in module sheaves [lem-pur-ringed-site-grothendieck-abelian]. For a finite row supported in $0\leq p<m$, each diagonal has at most $m$ nonzero summands.

For $g:Y\to X$ define $g^*_{\mathrm{CoCh}}(K)^q=g^*(K^q)$, with differential $g^*(d_K^q)$ and the same termwise rule on morphisms, in module sheaves over $g^{-1}A$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. Define the pulled-back ordered family by $(Y\times_XW_a\to Y)_a$. Equip these prolongations with zero-morphism preservation from the actual inverse/direct-image adjunction [def-sfb-proetale-unit-normalized-adjunction, lem-sfb-adjoint-functors-preserve-zero-morphisms]; the composite $E_i$ preserves zero morphisms by applying its two factors successively. These are construction conventions; covering, exactness, and base-change comparison assertions belong to their separate statement nodes.

The unit comes from def-sfb-proetale-unit-normalized-adjunction. (2) W_s is the product in Over X, so the empty product is X→X. (3) D^p is a product over t:Fin(p+1)↪o Fin m, with the projections.
